name: Robocopy2Rust Management Console
description: 100% pure-Rust native Win32 (WinSafe) & cross-platform Iced GUI wrapper, job orchestrator, CLI, and MCP server for Microsoft Robocopy.
majorCapabilities: 16 pre-flight validation rules & exit code decoder

tools.summary: Detect host OS, Robocopy executable availability, and configuration directory.
List all built-in Robocopy presets (safe backup, mirror, dry-run, NVMe, WAN, enterprise, move, LFSM).
Build a validated Robocopy command line plus optional .rcj, .bat, .ps1, and Windows Task Scheduler schtasks commands.
Parse a raw Robocopy command line or an .rcj job file path into a structured RobocopyJob and validation diagnostics.
Decode a Robocopy bitmask exit code (0-16) into severity, success boolean, and bit descriptions.
Manage saved persistent Robocopy job profiles (list, get, save, delete).
Run a safe non-destructive /L list-only Robocopy simulation and return parsed summary counts and file actions.
Execute a Robocopy job on the host OS. Refuses jobs with /MIR, /PURGE, /MOVE, or /MOV unless confirm_destructive is explicitly true.
Generate an air-gapped offline HTML, JSON, or Markdown audit report from a Robocopy log file or dry-run job.
